notes.title: Only 7 DAYS until the full game release!
notes.notes:
Hello-hello! 

Are you excited about the [b]Dynopunk[/b]'s release in a week? 👀 

We sure are! 🦾🦖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/b5334ec240bac96961595d9dc52c8812f44001fc.jpg[/img]

Final touches are being made, and we're almost ready to share with you what the future holds for our characters (weird to say, given the game's time travel plot, but we're sure you get it, heh).

So, just 7 days before the launch, and we've decided that it's time to reveal the price 🥁🥁🥁 

[b]14.99 USD[/b] with a [b]10%[/b] launch discount exclusively on Steam 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40313046/15dae4bb23447f37be69e7aa832515f21aa1dd92.gif[/img]

We're very thrilled about the release and hope you guys are just as hyped as we are! Thank you for all the love and support for our game 🥰 

Make sure to add the game to your wishlist and maybe even share it with a friend, that would help us a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1596730/Dynopunk/

Also, check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@tomatofantasy2328/]YouTube channel[/url] with some fun little videos we've made along the way. We will also release the OST for the game there soon after the release!

Oh, and if you want to chat with us, hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/MpJPKq4yyN]Discord server[/url], we'd love to meet and have a chat with all of you!
